what: one quantum on a line of 256 cells, 60 ticks, mass step exp(-i theta K) with the Higgs register of R8
tick: half-step frame M(theta/2) S M(theta/2), S the three routing shifts in the alternating order (on a line only axis 1 moves); flat static links
register_chart: K = |F><E| B + |E><F| B*, E/F the X_r = +1/-1 states; register phase phi (B = exp(i phi)) gives exp(-i theta (cos phi Z_r - sin phi Y_r)); phi = 0 is the toggle Z_r, the Higgs bit is B = X_h, K = Z_r X_h
preparation: R8 (r8_higgs_state.py section C, the packet test of routing.py): Routing((256,1,1)).packet(n0 = 12, width 3.0 in momentum index, coin branch_projected(p, theta) of the full-step symbol with kind Y, blank spin-up coin projected on the positive-phase branch), centre x = 0, carrier wave number 2 pi 12/256 = 0.2945; transported to the register chart by V = exp(-i pi/4 X_r) (V Y_r V* = Z_r; V commutes with the routing and with X_r, so densities and handedness are those of R8's packet in R8's chart)
positions: x in -128 .. 127 (x = cell index mod 256 taken in [-128, 128), R8 convention; initial mean 0); the density arrays below are ordered by x
handedness: right = X_r = +1 (neutral class), left = X_r = -1 (charged class)
frame_map: primary data: R8's packet carried into the half-step frame by the frame map of the common-phase sector, q = exp(+i theta/2 Z_r) q_R8 (the half-step tick is the end-frame tick conjugated by half a mass step, cf1_conformance.py item l3); the same quantum state is used with the register in number states. Variant without the frame map (R8's array as the initial state of the half-step tick) and R8's own frame: summaries below.

common_phase.register_state: one sector: every cell in the eigenstate of B with phase 0 (Higgs bit: X_h = +1 on every cell); exact, the register is unchanged

number_states_bit.register_state: Higgs bit of every cell in a number state h_x (the register of the Gauss test): uniform average over the 2^256 sign fields phi in {0, pi}, sampled

number_states_integer_counter.register_state: integer counter of every cell in a number state (R8 headline 16.5): uniform average over phase fields phi in [0, 2 pi), sampled
